name: Hearth
overview: The Scriptures depict the hearth as a central place of daily life and activity, symbolizing both provision and judgment. In Genesis 18:6, the hearth is the site where Sarah prepares food, emphasizing hospitality and sustenance. Conversely, Isaiah 30:14 uses the hearth metaphor to illustrate complete destruction, where no fragment remains to rekindle fire or draw water. Jeremiah 36:22-23 portrays the hearth as a place of warmth and authority in the king's winterhouse, yet also as the instrument of judgment when the king’s scroll is burned upon it, signifying the consuming power of God’s word and the seriousness of rejecting His message.
